verdict.rationale: The evidence shows item-level sharing controls: shared links with configurable access levels, and role-based collaborations that grant specific users or groups access. A community user also notes you can selectively grant outside parties access. None of this documents admin-level governance over external sharing. Missing for 10: org-level admin policies restricting who can share externally, domain allowlists/blocklists for collaborators, enterprise-wide shared-link restriction settings, and independent hands-on corroboration of admin governance.
